Fix ledger-sync gap: dog/scav/core/markov state pushes never fired

Two unrelated root causes behind stale Dashboard/Dogs Lab/Performance data:

- rider_state was a false alarm: push_ledger() was succeeding every
  cycle (confirmed via logs/rider_team.log), but never set updated_at
  explicitly, so fresh data looked stale.
- dog_state/scav_state/core_state/markov_state were a real bug:
  push_dogs/push_scavengers/push_core/push_markov only ever lived
  inside each module's own run_engine(), which run_all.py's worker()
  loop never calls (it drives run_cycle() directly). All four tables
  had been frozen since 2026-08-04 with nothing anywhere reporting it.

Fix: run_all.py's worker() now takes an optional push_fn, called after
every successful cycle, wired in for SCAV/DOGS/CORE/MARKOV. Every
push_* in sync_supabase.py now sets updated_at explicitly, returns
True/False, and reports every attempt to rider_health under
component='ledger_sync' so this can't go silently dark again.

Also fixes a bug caught mid-verification: a unicode checkmark in the
success message crashed on this machine's console encoding, which got
mistaken for a real failure and logged one false ERROR row even though
the underlying write had already succeeded. Success/failure is now
decided from the upsert alone, before any print.

Verified live: all 5 fleet tables confirmed fresh with real matching
balances immediately after the fix.

commit.message:
docs/CHANGELOG.md: log anchor writer invocation fix and cadence change

2026-08-11 entries for the by-path-vs-module invocation bug, the pre-logger
startup guard, the accidental extra cycle caught during verification, and
the 12h -> 8h cadence raise.

Raise anchor cadence to 8h for more on-chain samples before judging

CYCLE_SEC 12h -> 8h. MAX_FLR_PER_DAY 1.5 -> 1.8 (3 cycles/day x 5 calls x
~0.0926 FLR ~= 1.39; 1.8 gives headroom for gas spikes without effectively
disabling the cap). MIN_WALLET_BALANCE 5.0 -> 2.0, the deliberate floor to
spend this wallet down toward for the Aug 21 judging window. STARTUP health
row and the task description both reflect 8h automatically/explicitly.

Fix anchor writer scheduled-task invocation and add pre-logger guard

The task was registered by file path, which put flare/ (not Prv1311/) on
sys.path instead of the repo root, so import rider_team and from
supabase_client import ... failed before record_health was even importable.
Registered fine, exited immediately every run -- LastTaskResult 1, no log,
no process, invisible to the health-row architecture because the process
died before the logger existed.

Fixed both halves: the installer now invokes `python -m flare.anchor_writer`
with WorkingDirectory pinned to the repo root, matching the pattern already
used by install_divergence_recorder_task.ps1 and install_rider_flare_task.ps1.
And anchor_writer.py now wraps its own risky imports in a guard that prints
the reason to stderr and exits 78 on failure, plus refuses (exit 64) any
unrecognized command-line argument instead of falling through to the live
service -- closing the exact gap that let an unhandled --help trigger one
extra live anchoring cycle during this fix's own verification.

install_anchor_writer_task.ps1: register anchor_writer.py as a task

Same registration shape as the other five services (AtStartup, SYSTEM,
RestartCount 999, auto-start on registration so verification doesn't
wait for a reboot).

flare: add anchor_writer.py, unattended DivergenceAnchor recorder

Windows-service writer for the Flare mainnet DivergenceAnchor contract --
one recordDivergence call per symbol (OP/FLR/ARB/BTC/ETH) every 12h,
gated by four mechanical ceilings (chain id, wallet balance floor, daily
FLR spend cap, per-cycle call cap) in place of the interactive typed-
confirmation gate, since an unattended service has no console to prompt.

Add "Evidence of new work" table to CHANGELOG.md

Live-queried first/latest/count for rider_health, rider_decisions,
rider_cycles, oracle_divergence, footprint_nodes, and both local paper
ledgers -- machine-written operational records showing continuous activity
since 2026-08-05, independent of the squashed commit history.
